#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""check_repl_lag.py - replica lag (Seconds_Behind_Source) against warn/crit seconds."""
import argparse
import sys

import pymysql


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--warning", type=int, default=300, help="warn at this many seconds (default 300)")
    p.add_argument("--critical", type=int, default=600, help="crit at this many seconds (default 600)")
    p.add_argument("--defaults-file", default="/etc/icinga2/mysql-monitor.cnf")
    a = p.parse_args()
    conn = pymysql.connect(read_default_file=a.defaults_file)
    with conn.cursor(pymysql.cursors.DictCursor) as cur:
        cur.execute("SHOW REPLICA STATUS")
        lag = cur.fetchone()["Seconds_Behind_Source"]
    perf = f"lag={lag}s;{a.warning};{a.critical};0"
    if lag is None:
        print("MYSQL_REPL UNKNOWN - replication not running"); sys.exit(3)
    if lag > a.critical:
        print(f"MYSQL_REPL CRITICAL - Seconds_Behind_Source {lag} s > crit {a.critical} s|{perf}"); sys.exit(2)
    if lag > a.warning:
        print(f"MYSQL_REPL WARNING - Seconds_Behind_Source {lag} s > warn {a.warning} s|{perf}"); sys.exit(1)
    print(f"MYSQL_REPL OK - Seconds_Behind_Source {lag} s|{perf}"); sys.exit(0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
